phase: M3.2 frontend final seam review during development
authority: PRODUCT_DESIGN.md in current M3.2 worktree; no historical design package used.
scope: Independent bounded read-only review of Assessment attempt/preview and Workbench selection/restore seams; two temporary controlled React probes. No production/test repository changes and no full-suite/native rerun.

findings.production_entry: Shell.tsx recoverable snapshot button remains enabled while directory splitter and layout controls can call set().
steps: Choose another-window pending snapshot nav_width=320; hold the metadata GET.
Change current nav_width to 340 while GET is pending.
findings.impact: The edit made after the restore click is removed from both live state and its durable pending UI record without comparison.
findings.minimal_fix: Capture editing version and operation owner before awaiting; if a newer set or operation occurred, keep live/pending candidate and require a fresh explicit comparison before applying the older restore.

findings.production_entry: Shell.tsx error/conflict controls invoke reconnect(true), while the editable layout remains mounted.
steps: Explicitly choose the server session; hold metadata GET.
Change current nav_width to 340 while GET is pending.
findings.impact: An explicit choice made earlier is applied to later edits: the new pending UI is deleted and status becomes saved although no PUT persisted it.
findings.minimal_fix: Bind the explicit discard to the editing version present at click time; late reads must not discard later edits or reset their saved version. Keep candidate and expose a renewed comparison.

reproduction.command: PATH=<locked Node 24.21.0 bin>:$PATH apps/web/node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config <temporary probe>/vitest.config.mts
reproduction.boundary: Real React hook, React Query and jsdom localStorage; deferred metadata API adapter and unrelated object-draft hook mocked. No SQLite, real HTTP or native browser in this probe; no production rerender A-to-B assumption required.
reproduction.location: m32-workbench-seam-probe directory under the temporary root; originals retained

no_additional_findings_in_limited_static: AssessmentPreview and useAssessmentAttempt reject callback updates after unmount or target/workspace epoch change. Shell keys the actual preview/view by tab identity; artificial hook reuse is not asserted as a production defect.
Create retry retains a local command key until acknowledgement; save retries reuse revision/body key; submit/abandon recovery rereads actual server state and does not automatically resubmit.
Attempt two-read client compares snapshot and responses revision, retries at most four times, checks workspace/precise parent and assigned questions.
412/409 save handling retains current candidate and opens a base/local/remote comparison. Restore into terminal snapshot keeps candidate separate, and update/save/transition check active status.
Selection merge only restores unchanged null selections for matching tab context/precise references and does not treat deliberate full-view clear as untouched.

native_definitions: assessments.spec.ts: actual five question types, mode policies, server/local CAS, terminal local candidate preservation, delayed projected Workbench PUT, late Practice solution response
assessment-restart.spec.ts: exact target identity, actual browser/API restart, unsynced answer recovery, submitted private-answer protection
existing_test_scope_read_without_rerun.status: Definitions inspected; this review does not claim new pass counts for them.
